ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution consists of approximately 85% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary central region is a contiguous high-intensity white field; low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the peduncle insertion point and forms a continuous irregular band along the trailing edge; a high-contrast cluster of dark linear segments is located in the upper-left quadrant; a singular dark focal spot is present on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations visible across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of jagged peaks ranges from 5 to 25 pixels; the left lobe distal margin exhibits deeper, more irregular jagged interruptions compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a broadly convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of localized, high-intensity white circular pixel groups (consistent with calcified organisms) visible on the extreme tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of five distinct parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally in the upper interior section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks on the left lobe; a prominent dark circular puncture-style mark on the mid-right lobe; irregular deep indentation on the far-left trailing edge margin.
